question: Can the exact 2-divisibility relation R81-R105 ~ f105^*K_C2-f81^*K_C2 be upgraded to a theta/spin parity invariant that distinguishes or excludes any of the 29 residual Q=210+2r states?

ex1_05h.exact_use: R81-R105 ~ f105^*K_C2-f81^*K_C2, deg R105=2r, deg R81=48+2r, and K_C2 is twice a Weierstrass point class.

parent_05o.exact_use: All 29 Q states have the same three transvection-compatible Q602 mod-2 residues; 05P must therefore find an r-sensitive invariant rather than another uniform mod-2 action constraint.

external_spin_branched_cover.title: The theta characteristic of a branched covering
external_spin_branched_cover.exact_use: The pullback spin construction assumes only odd ramifications. Under that assumption the pulled-back differential has zeros of even multiplicity, giving a canonical theta characteristic; parity is encoded by the associated quadratic form on J[2].

picard_divisibility.exact_use: For a smooth projective curve over an algebraically closed field, Pic^0 is the group of points of an abelian variety and is divisible for n invertible in the field. Over C this implies every even-degree line bundle has a square root, with the roots forming a J[2]-torsor.

compatible_square_root_identity.choose_base_theta: Choose any theta characteristic eta on C2 with eta^2 ~= K_C2 and deg eta=1.
compatible_square_root_identity.square_root_existence: Because deg O(R105)=2r is even and Pic^0(D) is 2-divisible over C, choose M105 with M105^2 ~= O(R105).
compatible_square_root_identity.interpretation: The 2-divisibility relation does not create a parity mismatch. Compatible square roots make the two projection-induced theta characteristics literally the same line bundle.

noncanonical_root_firewall.root_change: Replacing M105 by M105 tensor gamma for gamma in J(D)[2] replaces the common theta characteristic by Theta tensor gamma.
noncanonical_root_firewall.reason: For a theta characteristic Theta, q_Theta(gamma)=p(Theta tensor gamma)+p(Theta) is a nondegenerate quadratic refinement of the mod-2 intersection form. Hence parity varies with 2-torsion twist in genus g(D)>0.
noncanonical_root_firewall.consequence: Even total ramification degree supplies square roots but no canonical parity invariant.

spin_hurwitz_applicability.canonical_half_ramification_condition: Every local ramification index e_p must be odd, so every coefficient e_p-1 of R is even and R/2 is an integral divisor.
spin_hurwitz_applicability.reason: An effective ramification divisor can have even total degree while containing odd coefficients, for example simple ramification points. The retained data do not rule these out or specify the branch-cycle profiles.

decision.exact_blocker: Need coefficientwise ramification profiles/branch cycles strong enough to define a canonical half-ramification spin structure, and then a source-bound parity/Sergeev invariant depending on r or on the three retained Q602 correspondence residues. Total ramification degrees and line-bundle 2-divisibility alone cannot do this.
decision.reopen_condition: Extract the actual ramification profiles of f105 and f81, or prove all ramification indices are odd with a canonical half-ramification divisor and compute its parity from actual monodromy.

next_route.selection_reason: 05P shows parity cannot see r without missing local branch profiles. The remaining non-reconstruction candidate attacks the stronger question whether any of the three Q602 Rosati residue classes can occur in an effective integral correspondence of the exact bidegree/self-intersection class on C2xC2.
